series.label: The series
series.headline: Eight of the last 12
series.line: Florida leads 31-10-3 and is 17-2 in Gainesville, where South Carolina's last win was 23-20 in overtime in 2014. The Gators have won the last two: 38-6 in The Swamp in 2022 and 41-39 in Columbia in 2023, when they scored twice in the final 4:40.

keys.label: Four keys

items.h: Stopping the SEC's top run game
items.p: South Carolina runs for 256.0 yards a game, No. 1 in the SEC and No. 7 nationally, at 6.5 a carry. Matt Fuller has 433 yards and 6.1 a carry; LaNorris Sellers has 391 and leads the SEC at 7.4. Florida held its first four opponents to 3.4 a carry, then Missouri ran 36 times for 220.

South Carolina has eight giveaways and two takeaways, a minus-6 margin that ranks No. 130 nationally in turnovers gained. Opponents have scored 34 points off Gamecock turnovers, and two lost fumbles set up 10 Kentucky points in last week's overtime loss. South Carolina is 1-3 when it loses the turnover battle.

items.h: Philo vs. the No. 125 pass defense
items.p: South Carolina's opponents have completed 65.8% for 1,156 yards, 13 touchdowns and two interceptions, No. 125 in FBS in pass efficiency defense. Aaron Philo is 84 of 121 for 1,114 yards, eight touchdowns and two interceptions, but Florida managed 5.8 yards an attempt when it had to throw from behind at Missouri.

The NWS puts the rain chance at 35% through 2 p.m. and 83% after, with about a third of an inch from 2 to 8 p.m. and a 33% chance of thunder from 2 to 5. Heat index 98 at 2 p.m., southeast wind 15 mph with gusts to 22. Lightning within 8 miles suspends play for at least 30 minutes.

lead.label: The Lead
lead.author: Franz Beard
lead.title: Florida vs South Carolina: Rain Could Turn Homecoming Into a Mud Bowl
lead.html: A wet Swamp favors South Carolina's run game and LaNorris Sellers, who averages 7.38 yards on designed runs and scrambles, against a Florida defense that gave up 220 rushing yards at Missouri. Franz Beard on why getting the lead, then holding it with Jadan Baugh and Duke Clark, is the key to Homecoming.
